name: Barbed Devil

actions.name: Claw
actions.effect: Target must pass PHYS save or be grappled as the barbs hook into flesh.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.effect: Ranged magical attack at long range. Flammable objects ignite.

reactions.name: Barbed Hide
reactions.effect: When hit by a melee attack from within reach or grappled, the attacker takes 2d8 piercing damage from the devil's barbs.

reactions.name: Magic Resistance
reactions.effect: +2d6 to a save against a spell or magical effect.

traits.name: Barbed Body
traits.desc: Any creature that grapples or is grappled by the Barbed Devil takes 1d8 piercing damage at the start of each turn.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Can see perfectly in magical and non-magical darkness up to 36m.

lore: Barbed Devils are covered head to toe in sharp, iron-hard barbs that make them walking torture devices. They serve as guards and jailers in the Nine Hells, delighting in the agony they inflict on anything that comes too close.
